name: Shikata Yuuhi
source:
4: The unlucky number who is hated.

‘Since I’m so weak I needed to be protected by a girl, I’m a worthless human being……’

High school 2nd year student.
A timid person and a pessimistic thinker. He is often bullied by delinquents like Tomoe in school. He loves the occult, and while he becomes very rarely passionate when talking about it, some consider this side of him creepy.

A member of Suu-ken.

Description from: https://riebakkari.wordpress.com/2016/02/14/suuran-digit-introduction/
